selection_protocol: epsilon-tolerance parsimony rule (Hastie et al., 2009; Breiman et al., 1984)

selected_for_production.selection_rationale: Following baseline GaussianNoise purge and sinusoidal PE buffer fix, Rank 1 (Trial 48) achieves dominant validation loss (0.003140) with compact d_model=32, H=2, and batch_size=64, guarding against noise overfitting without foreign artifacts.
Optimal Informer configuration with balanced head dimension (d_k=8), 3 distilling layers, and stable batch size 64.
Adheres to canonical Autoformer specifications with 8 multi-correlation heads (d_k=16), 4x feed-forward expansion (d_ff=512), and 0.10 dropout.
Textbook PatchTST parameters with patch length 8, stride 4, and d_k=32 multi-head attention.

Parsimonious selection over Rank 1: Rank 2 (Trial 45) provides canonical dropout=0.10 (vs 0.05 in Rank 1) and batch_size=128 (avoiding sharp minima of 256) within +0.61% delta, retaining textbook Vaswani d_ff=4*d_model and 3 layers.

Token-wise linear projection head realignment eliminates bottleneck, achieving superior val_loss of 0.002987 (-4.26% improvement). Rank 1 (Trial 30) selects balanced d_model=64, H=4 (d_k=16), and 2 layers with batch_size=64.
Standard LSTM baseline with input jitter removed. Rank 1 (Trial 42) achieves val_loss 0.003049 with d_model=64, 1 layer, and batch_size=128, improving upon previous noisy baseline.
Realigned multi-variate series decomposition with replicate padding according to Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023). Rank 1 (Trial 12) identifies a 6.5-hour trend window (kernel=13) with batch_size=32.
Max depth 4 avoids tree overfitting on flattened tabular lookback windows; subsample 0.66 provides robust bagging regularization.
Optimal LightGBM configuration with shallow tree depth (max_depth=4) to prevent tabular lag memorization, high min_child_samples (94) for noise resilience, and 60% column subsampling.
Selects most parsimonious (0, 1, 1)(1, 0, 1)_48 configuration with minimal AR/MA order (3 parameters) achieving lowest validation RMSE.
Project-wide top performer: 32-dim inverted variate tokens across 3 deep self-attention layers capture cross-variate correlations with minimal parameter footprint.

Within epsilon-tolerance (+0.88%), Trial 11 utilizes mini-batch size 128 (avoiding sharp minima of batch size 256 in Trial 14) and balanced 0.20 dropout rate to preserve stochastic gradient exploration and prevent overfitting.
Optimal single-layer linear head with weight decay regularization 6.4e-5 and standard Adam learning rate.
Standard GRU baseline with input jitter removed. Rank 1 (Trial 41) achieves val_loss 0.003044 (-2.15% improvement) with d_model=64, 1 layer, and batch_size=64.
Strictly aligned with canonical Wang et al. (2024) variate scanning (M=28 tokens) and RevIN. Rank 1 (Trial 49) achieves val_loss 0.004660 with d_model=128, d_state=32, 2 layers, and 0.20 dropout.
Numerical global minimizer with larger state dimension (d_state=16), robust 0.10 dropout, and kernel_size=37 for 18.5h diurnal trend filtering.

Within epsilon-tolerance (+0.077% loss difference), Trial 32 adopts canonical 0.10 dropout (vs 0.05 in Trial 48), mini-batch size 64 (vs 256), and compact d_model=32 (vs 64), providing robust regularization and stochastic exploration.
Global numerical minimizer outperforming runner-up by >6.7% while naturally satisfying production parsimony criteria: canonical dropout 0.10, mini-batch size 64, and compact d_model=32, d_state=32.
Dominant numerical minimizer satisfying parsimonious transformer criteria: canonical dropout rate 0.10, standard 4x FFN expansion (d_ff=256), 8 multi-scale attention heads, and mini-batch size 128.

Dominant numerical minimizer outperforming alternative configurations by >2.5% margin while embodying deep hierarchical feature extraction: 2-layer stacked LSTM, 2-layer self-attention encoder with 8 heads, and standard batch size 128.
Parsimonious selection: Rank 4 (Trial 44, val_loss 0.003135, +0.36% delta) incorporates stronger regularization (dropout=0.20 vs 0.15 in Rank 1) with decomposed 2-layer encoder and 1-layer decoder.
Rank 1 (Trial 38) achieves val_loss 0.003008 (-2.81% improvement) with compact channel_dim=64 (halved from 128), 4 layers, kernel_size=5, and 0.20 dropout.
Multi-rate hierarchical interpolation rerun. Rank 1 (Trial 13) achieves val_loss 0.003159 with standard_8_4_1 pooling, hidden_dim=256, and 3 layers.
Google TiDE architecture (Das et al., 2023). Rank 1 (Trial 5) achieves val_loss 0.006834 with d_hidden=256, d_dec=64, d_feat=16, 1 enc/dec layer, and 0.10 dropout.
Parsimonious selection: Rank 2 (Trial 1, val_loss 0.005187, +0.41% delta) utilizes stronger regularization (dropout=0.15 vs 0.05 in Rank 1) across generic residual stacks.
